about: A field of the element a list of records is indexed at, read in an assignment, an arithmetic operand and a guard. The read is checked as a list element's is: an index below zero, or not below the length, skips the statement it stands in (or makes the guard false) and raises error.execution, which the document counts in `refusals`. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: an empty list has no element at the cursor: nothing is read and the cursor does not move
nor a last one: len(days) - 1 is an unsigned underflow
the sum reads days[1], which a list of one does not have
the guard compares days[0] with days[1]: it is false and says so, and the unguarded `order` answers instead
12 < 20 holds, so the guarded `order` is taken
the last day, by an index computed from the length
index 3 is not below the length 3: nothing is read, and the cursor stays where it was
